name: Persons above the threshold who are not required must declare so on the invoice (rule 46(s))

attrs.quote: we are not required to prepare an invoice in terms of the provisions of the said sub-rule
attrs.scope: registered persons with turnover above the notified threshold who are not required to issue e-invoices
attrs.note: In force on publication, 5 July 2022, under the rules’ general commencement clause.
